biotools.summary: BioVizAI is a free, browser-local visualization workspace for creating publication-ready volcano, PCA, clustered heatmap, and box/violin figures from bioinformatics result tables and expression matrices. Scientific datasets and plotting computations remain in the browser. Users can configure preprocessing, thresholds, labels, colors, and statistical methods, then export editable SVG, vector PDF, 300 dpi PNG, and reproducibility reports.
biotools.name: BioVizAI
